fact: In Rwanda the NCI-CRVS database was connected to the National Population Register in 2020; for 2022 the report gives 93% birth registration and 31% death registration and says 69% of deaths were not notified to the register for deactivation of ID.
title: CRVSID Case Studies: Summary Report (Bangladesh, Bhutan, Colombia, Kenya, Namibia and Rwanda)
publisher: UNICEF / UN Legal Identity Agenda with Vital Strategies
